canonical_project: 2Africa Seychelles branch - North East Point landing
notes: Connectivity infrastructure, NOT a datacentre (no server/colo evidence found). Intelvision with Vodafone landed the 2Africa subsea cable at North East Point on 2023-04-20; expected live ~Sept 2023 (Nation). IFC financing up to US$20m for the branch. North East Point boundary straddles Anse Etoile and Glacis districts; recorded under Anse Etoile, Glacis scanned as cross-check with no separate DC evidence.
